## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: only Energy, Utilities and Industrials are showing clear 1W strength while major Tech and Comm names are weak, and there is a mixed mega-cap picture (NVDA ABOVE TREND; GOOGL BELOW TREND) — two independent signals supporting a neutral, mixed market.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +10.48%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities and Industrials also strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology weak overall with large-cap pressure: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION. Communication and Consumer Discretionary are also lagging, e.g., TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 concentrated in Utilities & Industrials).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION; CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -9.12% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION; ADBE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION; GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech/Comm names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: VST (1W: +10.76%), LMT (1W: +10.72%), CEG (1W: +9.46%); watch FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY for follow-through. Note major divergence: large 1W outperformance in cyclicals/utilities while several mega-cap Tech names show sharp 1W reversals — tactical, not broad.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to negative: NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND contrast with GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND and multiple CORRECTION patterns (META, ADBE, CRM, MSFT). Sector breadth: Technology underperformed this week (1W: -3.49%) indicating internal rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed/flat: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, but the Financials sector declined 1W (1W: -1.70%) and key cards show short-term CORRECTION (V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION). Style: no clear broad Financial leadership despite select names holding up.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Patchy but selective strength: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND; overall Healthcare 1W slightly negative (1W: -0.77%) so watch dispersion around winners.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
NEUTRAL stance — favor selective exposure to Energy and Industrials: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND and LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, and maintain Utility exposure (VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to weak large-cap Tech (GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION); style: Value/Cyclical favored within a neutral market.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.06%) and Industrials (1W: +2.55%) on strong 1W flows.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.49%), Communication (1W: -4.40%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: -4.53%) given concentrated mega-cap selling.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (hold recent 1M support to keep ABOVE TREND momentum). Monitor AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION — breach of the 1W pullback could signal deeper rotation. JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — break above last month highs would confirm Financial leadership. XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND — retention of 1M gains is key for Energy continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (+75): Boeing (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND — bullish FAA headlines but price remains BELOW TREND, so news is not yet confirmed by price (divergence).  
ACN (+75): Accenture — not in provided return set for cross-check; monitor for follow-through before treating as confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMD (-45): AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price is holding ABOVE TREND, a divergence that warrants monitoring for distribution.  
JPM (-45): JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — reputational headlines while price remains firm, another sentiment/price divergence to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy, Utilities and Industrials strength. XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND and LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated Tech/Comm selling (GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION) and several sentiment/price divergences deserve close monitoring.
